name: Wuzhou Special Paper Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Wuzhou Special Paper Group Co., Ltd. researches and develops, manufactures, and sells paper-based materials in China and internationally. The company offers food packaging materials, daily consumer materials, publishing and printed materials, industrial packaging materials, and industrial supporting materials series. It also provides glassine, tracing, transfer printing, and specialty cultural paper products. Wuzhou Special Paper Group Co., Ltd. was formerly known as Quzhou Wuzhou Special Paper Co., Ltd. The company was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Quzhou, China.
